description: Fabric mod that records Minecraft sessions (packets, movement, chunks)

mods.name: PacketLog
mods.description: Logs every packet the client sends and receives, decoded, to .minecraft/packetlogs, with per-tick player physics, applied velocities, screens and chunk/registry sidecars; serves them over a loopback-only MCP feed. With an upload key (/plog key), finished sessions upload to the server owner. Based on packetlog by starrrysky (MIT).
